description: Grants the settings window, every per-monitor snow overlay window and every per-monitor dock/taskbar decoration window access to core APIs (events, window control) and the app's own commands (list_themes, get_settings, save_settings, disable_everything, dock_status). Without a capabilities file, Tauri v2 denies ALL IPC calls for every window by default — this was previously missing entirely, which is why settings/themes silently never reached the backend.
